title: SQLoom: Set-Contrastive Learning of Syntactic, Semantic, and Logical Dependencies for Text-to-SQL
title_zh: SQLoom：面向 Text-to-SQL 的句法、语义与逻辑依赖集合对比学习

paragraphs.en: SQLoom通过三层监督的集合对比微调框架，将小模型Text-to-SQL准确率大幅提升并增强鲁棒性。 Text-to-SQL translates natural language questions into SQL queries, enabling database access without writing SQL. Fine-tuning open-weight large language models (LLMs) is cost-effective, but existing methods treat SQL as ordinary text and optimize token-level likelihood without explicitly modeling its syntactic, semantic, and logical requirements. Thus, a single incorrect alias or comparison operator can invalidate a query while contributing little to training loss. We propose SQLoom, a constraint-aware fine-tuning framework with supervision at three levels: syntactic validity under SQL grammar and database schema, semantic alignment between query decisions and the question, and logical consistency across dependent clause decisions. SQLoom extends supervised fine-tuning with a unified set-contrastive objective favoring sets of correct outputs over minimally different incorrect ones at each level. LLM agents propose this supervision, which a SQL parser and execution on counterexample databases verify. We also release Spider-Refined, a training dataset correcting 378 flawed Spider annotations and enriching database schemas. Experiments on Spider, BIRD, and three perturbed Spider variants show that SQLoom improves execution accuracy for Qwen3-1.7B from 62.9% zero-shot to 88.7% on Spider development, reaching 89.2% on Spider test and 73.4% on BIRD development. It outperforms fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and agent-based baselines with up to 70 billion parameters. On question perturbations, SQLoom loses at most 0.6 accuracy points versus up to 12.1 for agent-based methods. It generates SQL in a single pass at 0.42s per query, 23$\times$ faster than a GPT-4-based agent method. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of set-contrastive supervision over token-level training.
paragraphs.zh: SQLoom通过三层监督的集合对比微调框架，将小模型Text-to-SQL准确率大幅提升并增强鲁棒性。Text-to-SQL将自然语言问题转换为SQL查询，使用户无需编写SQL即可访问数据库。 微调开放权重大语言模型（LLM）具有成本效益，但现有方法将SQL视为普通文本，仅在词元级别优化似然，而没有显式建模其语法、语义和逻辑要求。 因此，一个错误的别名或比较运算符就可能使查询失效，而对训练损失的贡献却很小。 我们提出SQLoom，这是一个具有三层监督的约束感知微调框架：SQL语法和数据库模式下的语法有效性、查询决策与问题之间的语义对齐，以及依赖子句决策之间的逻辑一致性。 SQLoom在监督微调基础上扩展了一个统一的集合对比目标，在每一层上都偏好正确的输出集合而非差异极小的错误输出集合。 LLM智能体提出这种监督，并由SQL解析器和在反例数据库上的执行加以验证。 我们还发布了Spider-Refined，这是一个修正了378个有缺陷的Spider标注并丰富了数据库模式的训练数据集。 在Spider、BIRD和三个扰动Spider变体上的实验表明，SQLoom将Qwen3-1.7B在Spider开发集上的执行准确率从62.9%零样本提升至88.7%，在Spider测试集上达到89.2%，在BIRD开发集上达到73.4%。 它优于微调、强化学习以及基于智能体的方法，参数量最高达700亿。 在问题扰动方面，SQLoom最多损失0.6个准确率点，而基于智能体的方法最多损失12.1个点。 它以单次前向传播生成SQL，每个查询耗时0.42秒，比基于GPT-4的智能体方法快23倍。 这些结果表明，集合对比监督比词元级别训练更加有效。
